summary: v2.1.6 whoami fingerprint + unlock-code flow FULLY VALIDATED. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_whoami_and_auth.py. GET /api/whoami returns all 5 required fields with backend_origin='https://cryptostock-pro.preview.emergentagent.com' (respects X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Proto via ingress — not localhost:8001), db_name='aitrade_pro', codes_count=1 which matches actual admin/codes total, admin_tool_url = backend_origin + '/api/admin-tool' exactly, server_time in ISO-8601. GET /api/admin-tool HTML contains id='whoami-banner' and text 'BACKEND SAAT INI'. End-to-end auth flow: POST /api/admin/generate-code (X-Admin-Token) → POST /api/auth/verify with matching device_id → ok:true, duration:lifetime, expires_at:null, device_id echoed; same code with lowercase + whitespace still verifies; DIFFERENT device_id → ok:false reason:'device_mismatch'; unknown code → ok:false reason:'invalid_code'; DELETE cleanup 200; POST /api/admin/generate-code without token → 403. Regression: /api/, /api/profiles still 200. Frontend (390x844): header shows 'Ver 2.1.6'. LOGIN modal opens on tap of [data-testid=login-button]. Whoami fingerprint box appears within 1–2s with 'APK ini terhubung ke: https://cryptostock-pro.preview.emergentagent.com', 'DB: aitrade_pro', 'Codes: 1', 'Buka Admin Tool di URL YANG SAMA:' + full admin URL in dashed-border box. Tapping copy-admin-url swaps icon to green checkmark and shows 'URL disalin ke clipboard ✓' (clipboard permission granted; expo-clipboard call succeeded — no crash). Invalid login (kevchan1212@gmail.com + AAAA-BBBB-CCCC) shows red error 'Unlock code tidak ditemukan.' AND whoami box remains visible so user can visually confirm URL. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Carry-over warnings from prior iters (shadow* / pointerEvents RN-Web deprecations) still emit but no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/whoami (backend/server.py:944-969) correctly prioritizes X-Forwarded-Host + X-Forwarded-Proto for the ingress-visible origin, falls back to Host header, and finally to request.base_url. Verified via live curl to https://cryptostock-pro.preview.emergentagent.com/api/whoami → backend_origin matches ingress exactly (no localhost:8001 leak).
codes_count uses db.unlock_codes.count_documents({}) inside try/except returning -1 on failure — safe; matches admin/codes total in live test.
admin_tool_url is constructed as backend_origin + '/api/admin-tool' — exact string equality asserted in test.
auth_verify (backend/server.py:901-941) normalizes email/code with strip + upper before hitting verify_code — makes verification case-insensitive & whitespace-tolerant (verified end-to-end).

LoginModal.tsx fetches ${API_BASE}/whoami on visible=true with cancel guard — clean async pattern. Uses testIDs login-email-input / login-code-input / login-submit-button / login-error / copy-admin-url / login-close-button — all present and reachable.
expo-clipboard is used correctly with Clipboard.setStringAsync; setTimeout resets copied state after 1.8s — verified visually.
admin.html (static) fetches /api/whoami and populates #whoami-origin / #whoami-meta — banner present in served HTML per test_admin_tool_html_contains_whoami_banner.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: user-reported 'invalid_code' after 17+ attempts. Hypothesis (APK build pointing to a different backend/DB than the admin tool the user opened) is CORRECTLY addressed by v2.1.6. Verified: (1) /api/whoami returns the actual ingress origin, not localhost — so the URL shown on the APK screen IS the URL the APK is querying; (2) codes_count is a live count from the same DB the /api/auth/verify code path reads — mismatch would be immediately obvious in-app; (3) admin.html shows the SAME backend_origin banner — user can side-by-side compare; (4) auth/verify itself is fully functional and case/whitespace tolerant (previously good — now confirmed under regression). No code fix needed beyond what was already applied; the v2.1.6 UX makes the mismatch visible.
